notes_for_editor: Thin record. The NHLR page is the only tower-specific source; the Forest Fire Lookout Association list confirms the county and standing status. The 1932 build year, 2008 cab replacement and 2022 sale status come from the NHLR alone. The sale status is as of early 2022 and no later record was found, so the sale may have completed or changed. Agency is inferred from the statewide DNR decommissioning statements, not from a tower-specific record. No height appears in any source read, so no height_m is recorded. Access, climbability and rental are not in any source read. No photos added. Not verified: whether the sale completed, who owns the tower now, or its current condition.
